title: Lightroom Export Photo File Size Leaderboard
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lightroom:photo file_size_mb=*
| stats sum(file_size_mb) as total_value, avg(file_size_mb) as avg_value by collection_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks collection name values by total and average file size across Lightroom export photo events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `file_size_mb` values for each Lightroom export photo event and review total and average file size by collection name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total file size.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which collection name shows the biggest file size numbers in your Lightroom export photo data.
